nodes.description: Private owner address state variable; used as the sole privilege check for init, batchSend, delegate and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated with raw unchecked subtraction/addition in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances; written in approve/transferFrom/constructor and decremented without SafeMath.
tradeAddress state variable whitelisted in ensure(); set by setTradeAddress.
Mapping of addresses allowed to bypass the sale-condition checks in ensure().
_saleNum state variable limiting the number of sales per address; set in init.
_minSale state variable; minimum transfer value enforced by condition().
_maxSale state variable; maximum transfer value enforced by condition().
_onSaleNum per-address counter of outbound transfers, incremented in transferFrom.
Public totalSupply; assigned in the constructor with unchecked multiplication.
Constant decimals = 18 used for scaling in init and the constructor.
Constant hard-coded router address 0x7a25...488D whitelisted in ensure().
Public token name set by the constructor.
Public token symbol set by the constructor.
Public payable transfer(_to,_value) that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value), bypassing the internal checks of the caller.
Internal view gatekeeper: builds the Uniswap pair via pairFor, whitelists owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale addresses, otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transferFrom: checks allowance, calls ensure(), then performs unchecked balance updates and increments _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve that unconditionally overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-window logic reading _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale/_onSaleNum and rejecting transfers outside the window.
Public payable delegate(address a, bytes b) restricted to owner that executes a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary address.
Owner-only init setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with unchecked multiplications.
Owner-only batchSend looping over _tos, deducting a computed total and crediting recipients with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using create2-style keccak hashing.
Payable constructor minting totalSupply to msg.sender, setting owner and an unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
External caller identity (msg.sender) used for privilege checks and as the implicit source of transfer/approve operations.
Arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address inside delegate(); executes untrusted code with the contract's storage context.
Raw allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value subtraction without SafeMath or underflow protection.
Raw balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value mutations without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) in init.
Unchecked computation uint total = _value * _tos.length plus balanceOf additions inside the batchSend loop.
Parameter _to of transfer().
Parameter _value of transfer().
Parameter _from of ensure(); compared against owner/UNI/tradeAddress whitelists.
Parameter _value of ensure() forwarded to condition().
Parameter _from of transferFrom(); debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom(); credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom(); drives allowance and balance arithmetic.
Parameter _spender of approve().
Parameter _value of approve().
Parameter _from of condition(); used to index _onSaleNum.
Parameter _value of condition(); compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
Parameter a of delegate(); arbitrary target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate(); arbitrary calldata payload.
Parameter saleNum of init(); assigned to _saleNum.
Parameter token of init(); scaled into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init(); scaled into _maxSale.
Parameter _tos of batchSend(); recipient array iterated in the loop.
Parameter _value of batchSend(); per-recipient amount multiplied by array length.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress(); new whitelisted trade address.
Loop counter i in batchSend().
Local _to extracted from _tos[i] inside batchSend().
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend().

edges.reason: _to parameter flows into transfer() which forwards it to transferFrom().
_value parameter flows into transfer() and on to transferFrom().
transfer() calls transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value), routing execution into the state-mutating function.
msg.sender is compared with _from and indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender], controlling who may spend the allowance.
_from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom().
_to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom().
_value parameter drives the allowance and balance arithmetic.
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) as a gate before mutating balances.
transferFrom() performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
_value is the amount subtracted from the caller allowance, enabling underflow.
_value is added to and subtracted from balances with no overflow guard.
ensure() calls condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair whitelist address.
_from determines whether the sender bypasses the sale restriction via the whitelist comparisons.
_value is forwarded from ensure() to condition().
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of allowed sales.
condition() reads _minSale for the minimum transfer threshold.
condition() reads _maxSale for the maximum transfer threshold.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale inside condition().
_from indexes _onSaleNum, determining the per-address sale quota.
Attacker-influenced address a is the target of the delegatecall, granting arbitrary code execution over contract storage.
Caller-supplied bytes b is used verbatim as delegatecall calldata.
delegate() executes the unsafe delegatecall on an arbitrary address.
msg.sender must equal owner to reach the delegatecall.
owner is the sole authorised caller of delegate().
owner is the sole authorised caller of init().
msg.sender is checked against owner in init().
saleNum parameter is written into _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled and written into _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled and written into _maxSale.
token is multiplied by 10**decimals with no overflow protection.
maxToken is multiplied by 10**decimals with no overflow protection.
_minSale is the result of the unchecked multiplication in init().
_maxSale is the result of the unchecked multiplication in init().
init() writes the unchecked product into _minSale.
init() writes the unchecked product into _maxSale.
init() assigns the caller-supplied saleNum to _saleNum.
_tos array drives the batchSend loop length and recipients.
_value is the per-recipient amount credited in batchSend().
msg.sender must equal owner and is the account debited by the batch total.
owner is the sole authorised caller of batchSend().
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
_value multiplied by an attacker-controlled array length can overflow total.
batchSend() mutates balanceOf with raw subtraction and per-recipient addition.
Loop variable i controls iteration over _tos in batchSend().
Local _to = _tos[i] is the credit target inside the batchSend loop.
Local total drives the balanceOf[msg.sender] deduction in batchSend().
addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress whitelist entry.
msg.sender is checked against owner in setTradeAddress().
owner is the sole authorised caller of setTradeAddress().
setTradeAddress() writes the caller-supplied address into tradeAddress, affecting ensure() whitelisting.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve().
_spender parameter is the allowance grantee in approve().
_value parameter is the allowance amount written in approve().
The constructor assigns msg.sender to the privileged owner variable.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the entire initial supply.
The constructor computes totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication.
The constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the hard-coded UNI router.
